Title: Ambtenarenbal 2027
Description: In keeping with tradition, the ‘New Year’s Ball’ (also known as the civil servants’ ball) takes place on the first working day of the new year. Tickets can be purchased at the ticket office on 4 January. Everyone is welcome!

Title: Gelukkig Zijn Sessie @ GC Essegem
Description:
This session will take place at GC Essegem , rue Léopold I 329, 1090 Jette. Doors open at 09:30 and we’ll start singing at 10:00. The session is scheduled to finish at 11:30.

Do you want to improve your Dutch and do you enjoy singing? Then you’ve come to the right place! Every month, accompanied by two musicians and a set list full of Dutch-language classics, we head to a different community centre in Brussels. There, we practise Dutch together.... through singing!

Through Dutch-language songs, you’ll get to know the language better in a fun and accessible way. At the same time, you’ll discover more about Belgian culture and meet new people. Three birds with one stone!

And don’t worry: you don’t need to be Ann Christy or Clouseau. Fun and enthusiasm are what matter most. You don’t need to be a talented singer!

We’ll provide a pianist, a lead singer, the song lyrics and a free drink. Everyone is welcome and the sessions are free . Registration is required, though.

Take a look at our schedule and find out when we’ll be singing near you. Fancy warming up your vocal cords in the meantime? Check out this season’s setlist here !

In collaboration with the Taalunie , Theater van A tot Z and the Flemish Community Commission (VGC).

Title: Étienne Daho
Description:
To mark the 40th anniversary of Pop Satori and the 30th anniversary of Eden, Étienne Daho will be staging a series of exceptional concerts, revisiting these two classic French pop albums on stage and performing them in their entirety.

Driven by pop and electro arrangements, iconic tracks such as ‘Épaule Tattoo’, ‘Au commencement, ’, ‘Tombé pour la France’, ‘Soudain’, ‘Duel au soleil’ and ‘Le premier jour du reste de ta vie’… will regain their timeless power, bearing witness to the enduring influence and uniqueness of this major figure in the French music scene.

Title: Lelee + Jelena Petošević
Description:
This is a Liveurope concert, the first European initiative that supports concert venues in promoting emerging musical talent from Europe.

Europe isn’t just this side of the continent; in the East, too, a huge amount of great and fascinating music is being made, which, sadly, doesn’t reach our part of the world often enough. We’ve already had the chance to discover plenty of musical gems thanks to festivals organised by our Liveurope partners across Europe, but our Slovenian sister venue, Kino Šiška (in Ljubljana – definitely pop in if you’re passing through), is keen to break down barriers and send interesting bands our way.

A year ago, we saw the trans-Balkan trio Lelee perform live and were immediately captivated by their melodic indie songwriting with a strong pop sensibility, wrapped up in a punk-style DIY ethos. The trio – Jelena Rusjan (vocals and bass), Damjan Manevski (vocals and guitar) and Miha Konrad (drums) – deserve their prominent place in the regional alternative music scene, thanks to their lively, exhilarating indie guitar sound and the interweaving of male and female vocals, Their fresh, harmonious and playful sound combines the legacy of 1980s Yugoslav new wave and the indie and slacker rock vibes of the 1990s with a distinct Adriatic flair, striking a balance between inventive arrangements and unbridled rock energy. With hundreds of gigs under their belt, Lelee have evolved into a powerful, razor-sharp live band.

Title: Suzane
Description: Suzane won over audiences with her boundless energy, remarkable stage performances and socially conscious lyrics. After making a lasting impression with her albums ‘Toï Toï’ and ‘Caméo’, the artist returned to the spotlight with a 2025-2026 tour, including a sold-out show at Ancienne Belgique in February 2026.

Title: Joe Yorke + Mad Codiouf
Description: Singer and composer Joe Yorke , originally from Northwest England, became captivated by punk, folk, and reggae during his early teens. After mastering various songs on the guitar, he became a familiar sight on the streets of Wigan and Manchester, busking his favorite tracks. A visit to the Notting Hill Carnival in 2006 introduced him to British sound system culture -an experience that immediately inspired him to become part of the movement. In his late teens, he moved to Moss Side, Manchester, where he fully immersed himself in the thriving local dub and reggae scene. He played with the group Black Star Dub Collective and took part in weekly jam sessions—an ideal training ground and meeting spot for talented musicians within the local reggae community. By combining live music with sound system culture, Joe Yorke embraces the full spectrum of the reggae scene. In recent years, the the young thirty something has made waves in the international reggae world with breathtaking live performances and a string of singles, EPs, and albums that have found their way into both record crates and the hearts of roots and soul music lovers. Through collaborations with acts such as Stand High Patrol, L’Entourloop, Gentleman's Dub Club , and O.B.F. , as well as major festival appearances and tracks played by sound systems worldwide, this newly adopted Bristolian has won over audiences with his roots, rocksteady, and dub sound.

Title: Imminence + House of Protection, August Burns Red
Description:
What began in 2010 as a dream shared by Eddie Berg (vocals/violin) and Harald Barrett (guitar) has since grown into a global phenomenon. Following two EPs and their debut album ‘I’, the band finally broke through to the mainstream in 2015 with the single “The Sickness”. Five albums later, including the successful, most recent album ‘The Black’ from 2024, Imminence has established itself as one of the most innovative acts within the genre. The band flawlessly interweaves heavy guitar riffs with classical violin arrangements, switching effortlessly between clean vocals and aggressive vocals. With their profound lyrics and layered compositions, they consistently strike a chord, offering their fans a deep sense of comfort and togetherness. In addition to their musical strengths, the group excels by placing a strong emphasis on independence, artistic control and environmental sustainability. It is with this vision that Imminence continues to inspire and connect with their growing fanbase.

With the impressive vocals and live violin parts of frontman Eddie Berg, supported by the powerful guitar work of Harald Barrett and Alex Arnoldsson and the rumbling bass of Christian Höijer, it promises to be an unforgettable and intense evening.

Title: Bellaire
Description: The heir apparent to 90s funky house, Bellaire has turned his teenage passion for hip-hop sampling into an artistic mission: to make soulful house accessible to a new generation. Recognizable by his iconic mustache, cap, and funky glasses, he has established himself since the viral success of “Paris City Jazz” (2018, certified international gold record) as the missing link between the golden age of the movement and today's dancefloors. Supported by more than 180,000 fans and recognized by the legends he admired (DJ Spen, Mousse T, Yuksek), he embodies an accessible, joyful, and deeply groovy house music.

Title: Lord Of The Rings and The Hobbit in concert
Description:
! ‍ Experience , & in Concert - presented by a star guest from the films! Enjoy the unique music worlds of J.R.R. Tolkien in a magnificent concert featuring world-class star soloists, the voice of legendary Saruman actor Sir Christopher Lee, and the Orchestra and Choir of the Shire: From the menacing sounds of Mordor and shrill attacks of the Black Riders to the beautiful, lyrical melodies of the Elves.

Enjoy the only film music concert series in the world with a star guest from the Lord of The Rings & Hobbit films, who will not only present the best music from "The Lord of the Rings, The Hobbit & The Rings of Power - The Concert”, but also be available for a free picture with you if you buy your tickets today!

Title: The Music Of Hans Zimmer & Others
Description:
& — presented by a pirate from ! Experience the unique and best film scores from , , , , , , , and many other top productions — in a breathtaking concert featuring The Hollywood Film Orchestra & choir, star soloists and selected film clips!

Including the Oscar-winning, extraordinary soundscapes of !

Enjoy the only film music concert series in the world with a presenter from the films, who will not only present the best music of Hans Zimmer, but also be available for a free picture with you if you buy your tickets today! Immerse yourself in the musical universe of Hans Zimmer and secure your tickets now if still available!

Title: Namiddagconcert: Johan Verminnen, Afscheid Van Een Zanger
Description: Namiddagconcert: Johan Verminnen, Afscheid Van Een Zanger live at AB Concerts, Brussels (AB Main hall).

Title: TumbleJack
Description:
Get ready for one of the most exceptional live bands on the Belgian roots scene. Yes, it’s still alive and kicking! Tumblejack is a new Belgian band that brings together an exceptional group of musicians centred around Nils De Caster and Sara De Smedt. The repertoire consists mainly of original material, with the occasional nod to the artists and musical traditions that have inspired the band members. In the spring of 2026, eight concerts were recorded in Belgium and the Netherlands. The songs were written especially for this project and took their final shape on stage, in direct interaction with a live audience. At the end of 2026, the live album You Know How It Ends will be released, featuring recordings from that concert series and the catchy Changes as the first single. It’s set to be a heart- and soul-warming early Sunday evening at our Club!

Other band members: Steven De Bruyn – harmonica, percussion Ht Roberts – bass, banjo Bart Vervaeck – electric guitar, pedal steel David Broeders – drums, mandolin

Title: Klassiek met De Keere: Happy Birthday Philip Glass!
Description: A birthday worth marking: Philip Glass, pioneer of musical minimalism.

Title: Isaiah Rashad
Description: Isaiah Rashad expands his musical world beyond hip-hop for this third studio album It’s Been Awful , which contains influences from cosmic jazz, psychedelic guitar-rock, neo-soul and genre-defying experiments. After five transformative years, Rashad delivers his most vulnerable and refined work to date: an unfiltered reflection on addiction, personal growth, soul-searching and reconciliation. Since breaking through in 2012 from out of Chattanooga, Tennessee, he has established one of the most influential and emotionally resonant catalogues in modern rap. His debut Cilvia Demo (2018) immediately established him as an important force in the music world. The House Is Burning (2021) strengthened his cultural impact further. The album amassed almost a billion streams worldwide and received wide acclaim for its introspective storytelling and musical evolution. Rashad has never been swayed by trends as he consistently pursues timeless and deeply personal music. It’s Been Awful is now the start of a new chapter, one marked by clarity, confrontation and creative rebirth.

Title: JGrrey
Description:
JGrrey pushes the boundaries between neo-soul, hip-hop and R&B, with a sound that is both vulnerable and distinctive. In 2017, her version of Don’t Fade for COLORSxSTUDIOS put her on the map. It marked an important moment in her musical journey, attracting new listeners eager to discover the British singer who had previously been sharing raw, unmixed experimental neo-soul on SoundCloud. Billie Eilish was also drawn to her music and invited JGrrey to support her on her European tour.

On her debut album, you, me & jen , JGrrey turns inward. She explores different sides of herself, sharing personal stories about identity, self-confidence and connection. She sees music as a way of making difficult emotions tangible: “ Music is a way of taking those hard to feel emotions and holding them up to a light. ”

Vulnerable and sincere, yet playful and full of humour, JGrrey shows her most personal side.

Title: Bart Peeters & De Ideale Mannen: première ‘We Zijn Ermee Bezig’-tour
Description:
Duration of the performance: two sets of 1 hour each, with an interval.

Bart August Maria Peeters sold out Antwerp’s Lotto Arena more than 20(!) times with the Bart Peeters Deluxe concert series that took place in late 2024 and early 2025 – attracting a staggering 100,000(!) wildly enthusiastic concertgoers. He heads out on the road again in early 2027, to more intimate venues and (in his own words) “the most beautiful venues in the country”.

By the way, there’s a hidden gem stashed in the tour bus trailer, one which will be revealed in all its glory on this evening: his b-r-a-n-d- n-e-w album We zijn ermee bezig . The advance single De Bevalligste is an instant Bart Peeters classic and, indeed, a genuine ode to his granddaughter.

Lastly, a warm personal welcome from Mr Peeters himself:

After three years of theatre-silence, we’re embarking on a tour of the country’s finest venues. The reason is simple: new songs that I’m particularly proud of. We tested them during wonderful living-room concerts and felt: this is right, this works, it all came so naturally...

The challenge for the new theatre tour will be: to make people happy with well-known songs, but definitely also to surprise them with fresh ideas. To get that balance just right, we will play a sold show in two parts, no half measures.

Of course, I’ll be playing with De Ideale Mannen again. I’m also proud to announce that Tom Vanstiphout , my favourite guitar wonder, will be joining us to make the party complete.

Title: Black Veil Brides + The Funeral Portrait, The Howling
Description:
Hailing from Cincinnati, Black Veil Brides have emerged as one of the most striking of the modern rock and metal scene. What began as the creative project of frontman Andy Biersack has evolved over the past fifteen years into a band with a global fanbase, millions of streams and an impressive track record of successful albums and sold-out shows. Black Veil Brides built a universe all of their own with a mix of melodious metal, grandiose choruses and dark, dramatic vibes. Classics like Knives and Pens , In the End , Fallen Angels and Scarlet Cross have become staples of the genre and confirmed the band’s status as one of the most important modern rock acts of their generation. Today, Black Veil Brides consists of Andy Biersack, Jake Pitts , Jinxx , Christian Coma and Lonny Eagleton . Their seventh studio album, VINDICATE , sees the band return to the essence of their sound: powerful songs, compelling melodies and an uncompromising vision that has set them apart from the start.

VIP PACKAGE: - One (1) General Admission Ticket - Meet & Greet with Black Veil Brides - Photo Opp w/ Black Veil Brides - Exclusive Tour Patch - Signed VIP Poster - Souvenir Laminate w/ Lanyard - Early Entry - Early Access to Merch

Title: Manassé
Description: Manassé is an alternative pop artist with indie rock influences, who transforms heartbreak, loneliness and intrusive thoughts into songs that offer hope.

Title: Finn Loxbo
Description:
With Finn Loxbo , AB welcomes one of the most distinctive voices on the contemporary Swedish improvisation scene. The Stockholm-based guitarist moves effortlessly between two extremes: understated, acoustic soundscapes and relentless sonic outbursts. As a solo artist, but also through projects such as Kommun, Skogen, Kyosaku and Anna Högberg Extended Attack , he has developed a unique musical language in which free improvisation, composition and experimentation constantly merge.

On his recent solo album “Lummernikt” (released on John Chantler’s Fönstret label), Loxbo resolutely opts for the acoustic guitar. With astonishing technique, unusual playing styles and a keen sense of form, he creates music that sounds at once organic, hypnotic and surprisingly accessible. The British music magazine The Quietus named the record ‘Album of the Week’ and praised the way in which Loxbo transforms free improvisation into something exceptionally refined and poetic. Don’t expect a traditional guitar recital, but rather a captivating listening experience in which every note is born in the moment.

‘one of the year’s most entrancing acoustic guitar albums, weaving together glimmering melodic fragments and fleet fingerpicking with an avant-garde approach to timbre and resonance.’ The Wire, Oct 2026

Title: Hollywood Porn Stars
Description:
Hollywood Porn Stars is a Belgian indie rock band formed in 2002 in Liège. They gained attention by winning the Circuit contest Just three months after forming and soon signed with the frenc label Naïve, securing international distribution. Their music blends raw energy, sharp guitar riffs, and melancholic melodies, drawing inspiration from bands like Sonic Youth, Pixies, and Nirvana. Although the band was initially active for only six years, they had a meteoric career, playing over 300 concerts and releasing two albums and three EPs. Some of their "classics tracks" like Actarus received heavy rotation on European radios and MTV, while tracks like Starwest or Fugitive are still frequently used for television soundtracks and promos. After this intense period, the members pursued parallel projects, including Piano Club, My Little Cheap Dictaphone and active involvement in the indie label JauneOrange

They performed many times at Belgium’s biggest venues and festivals, including Ancienne Belgique, Les Ardentes, Pukkelpop, and Dour Festival, and internationally at Eurosonic, Great Escape, Haldern Pop, Paleo, Les Vieilles Charrues, Solidays, and notably sharing the stage with Primal Scream at London’s legendary Fortress, as well as legends like Iggy Pop, Patti Smith, Sonic Youth, and more

Their live performances earned them an Octave de la Musique for Best Live Band.

Title: Matinee concert: Hendrik Lasure presenteert De Val
Description: With ‘De Val’, Hendrik Lasure (schntzl, Bombataz) presents a new collection of wondrous songs that hover between dream and reality. Whereas his 2022 debut ‘Het Wiel’ looked back on his childhood, he now explores themes such as connection, longing and melancholy. Live, Lasure brings the musicians from the album onto the stage: Meskerem Mees, Jolan Decaestecker, Aya Suzuki and Sep François, amongst others, bring to life his unique universe of poetic lyrics, subtle arrangements and spellbinding melodies. Cabaret for the 21st century. Don’t expect a traditional singer-songwriter evening, but rather a concert that transports you to magical-realist landscapes where castles, moats and purple evening skies coexist effortlessly. Lasure has quickly established himself as one of the most distinctive voices on the Flemish music scene.

Title: J.Bernardt
Description:
J.Bernardt , aka Jinte Deprez , also a member of the iconic band Balthazar , is a true jack-of-all-trades. Singer, songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, arranger, producer, sound engineer, and programmer—he does it all. With Four In The Morning he unveils his first new track since 2024. The song marks a new step in his journey, with a more defined artistic identity and a musical aesthetic that reflects his personality more than ever. For this new release, he flew to 64 Sound Studio in Los Angeles, where he collaborated with producer Paul Butler , known for his work with Michael Kiwanuka and Devendra Banhart . The result is a track that retains J.Bernardt’s recognizable signature while sounding freer, bolder, and more spontaneous.

“This track immediately caught my attention because it’s not the kind of song I usually write. There was a kind of almost manic urgency that made me feel like something was calling me. So I went for it, probably carried by the sense of rebirth the song gave me. Why not? I wanted to feel reborn. That’s how this image came about: a dancer in his finest suit, wandering through Los Angeles at four in the morning. I just hope everything turns out well for him.” – Jinte Deprez about Four In The Morning

With this new material, Jinte reveals himself to be freer and more spontaneous than ever: wild, warm, and full of life. A soundtrack already perfect for summer, but one that will fit just as well during a winter evening live at AB.

Title: Ino Casablanca
Description:
This is a Liveurope concert, the first European initiative that supports concert venues in promoting emerging musical talent from Europe.

Ino Casablanca, a Franco-Moroccan artist born in Spain, draws on his multicultural background to create a hybrid style of music blending rap, acoustic and electronic sounds, as well as Maghreb, Caribbean and Latin influences. Self-taught, he began composing at the age of 14. Following the EP Tamara , which showcased his innovative and personal approach, he released Extasia a few months later. Neither ostentatious nor contrived, the Franco-Moroccan artist crafts instinctive music, fuelled by rhythms from afar and melodies that know no boundaries, thereby gradually establishing himself on the Francophone music scene. He will present his new album Extasiaaaa with 10 new songs in a 12 dates tour in France en exclusively for Belgium in AB!

Title: Susobrino
Description: Susobrino , the Brussels-based artist of Bolivian origin, returns to AB after his sold-out show to promote the album SU SO BRI NO , in 2024. However, this time he’ll be performing in the Main Hall with a new album that is entirely dedicated to cumbia. He explores, dissects and reinterprets the genre by way of his distinctive blend of acoustic and electronic sounds, complemented by surprising guest appearances. Susobrino is known for his performances that effortlessly shift between emotionality and danceability. At AB, he brings his unique combination of Latin American roots and electronic explorations to the stage once again. A Friday evening in which concert and afterparty converge, curated by Susonidos. VAMOS!

Title: Anne Clark & Band
Description:
Anne Clark returns in 2027 with “Edge Of Silence,” a tour set against a world that feels close to its own breaking point. She steps back into the spotlight as a witness rather than a commentator, using decades of creative evolution to frame a moment marked by tension and uncertainty. Since the early eighties, Clark has been one of the defining figures linking electronic music, spoken word and post punk. Her influence threads through both underground movements and mainstream culture. Concert halls across Europe, the USA and Canada have carried her voice. Tracks like “Sleeper in Metropolis” and “Our Darkness” remain touchstones for listeners who grew up with them and for younger audiences discovering them anew. The 2027 tour is not a retrospective. It leans on her history only to sharpen the present. Clark and her band construct a sound that shifts between electronic edge and acoustic detail. Long familiar pieces reappear with a more distilled focus. New material looks directly at a world where calm is fragile. “Edge Of Silence” offers a space stripped of distraction. Words and sound are placed with precision.

Atmosphere matters as much as impact. Clark performs with the clarity of someone who has seen cultural cycles rise, fall and return in unexpected forms. Her voice has followed audiences through many unsettled periods. In 2027, she stands at another threshold, observing it with the same steady lens that has defined her work for more than four decades.

Title: Sunday Morning Concert: Jean J. Boudart
Description:
After two years in the turbulent world of De Vlaamse Primitieven, which included the albums ‘Lucht van een Andere Planeet’ and ‘Brandstichters & Oplichters’, Jan Boudart steps into the spotlight as Jean J. Boudart with his first solo album ‘Le Jardin Ultraviolet’ (Klankhaven).

Since 2018, he has been exploring new possibilities for the guitar, focusing on resonance, overtones, harmonics and endless drones. What began as an experiment grew into a five-part composition that developed organically over the years. The switch from a six-string to a ten-string guitar opened up a whole new sonic universe.

On ‘Le Jardin Ultraviolet’, influences from minimalism, raga and impressionist music converge to create a hypnotic, immersive listening experience. The album is a sonic painting that explores the boundaries of our perception and pays homage to the invisible and the intangible.

Title: Ayra Starr
Description:
“Who’s that girl, who’s that girl, what’s popping? ’ If you don’t know the answer yet, it’s time to discover the Ayra Starr phenomenon! This Benin-Nigerian singer, a rising star on the Afrobeat scene, has announced her return to Belgium. Armed with her new album ‘Starrgirl’ and her many hits, she’s ready to set the Ancienne Belgique in Brussels alight on Sunday 31 January 2027.

Ayra Starr has quickly established herself as one of the most distinctive voices of her generation. The Benin-Nigerian singer is known for her catchy Afrobeat anthems and her confident style. With over 7 billion streams worldwide and more than a billion views on YouTube, she has won over audiences and critics alike. Since the release of her groundbreaking debut album ‘19 & Dangerous’, Ayra Starr has been one of the most promising stars on the African continent. She has already collaborated with some of the biggest names in the music scene, including Wizkid, Stormzy, Rema, Coldplay, Tiwa Savage and Leigh-Anne, and has also received support from renowned artists such as Rihanna. With the track “Rush”, released in 2022, Ayra Starr has quickly become one of the leading figures in Afrobeat, with nearly a billion streams worldwide. Recognised early on as an emerging phenomenon, she has secured nominations at the Grammy Awards, the Billboard Music Awards, the BET Awards, the MTV Video Music Awards and the Soul Train Awards, amongst others.
